# Commands

Each command takes the task as its argument, for example `/ultracode "Add a --dry-run flag"`. A command that gets too little context asks for the missing goal, scope or acceptance criteria before it starts.

## Workflow commands

| Command | Mode in the record | Changes code | Ends with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/ultracode` | `build` | yes | the gate's status |
| `/ultracode-debug` | `debug` | yes | the gate's status |
| `/ultracode-verify` | `verify`, or the mode of the open workflow | no | the gate's status |
| `/ultracode-spec-audit` | `spec-audit` | no | findings, status `research-only` |
| `/ultracode-research` | `adversarial-research` | no | findings, status `research-only` |
| `/ultrathink` | `adversarial-research` | no | a recommendation, status `research-only` |
| `/ultrathink-fusion` | `adversarial-research` | no | a recommendation, status `research-only` |
| `/ultracode-fusion` | `build` | depends on the task | the gate's status and a fusion trace |

`/ultracode` is labelled `comprehensive` in its prompt. The record stores it as `build`.

## Which record a command uses

| Situation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| No workflow is open in this session | The command starts an empty record. |
| A workflow of the same mode is open in this session | The command continues it. |
| A workflow of another mode is open in this session | The command starts an empty record. `/ultracode-verify` is the exception: it continues the open workflow. |
| The open workflow belongs to another session | The command starts an empty record. |

A workflow is open until its completion report ends it or its phase is set to `completed`. See [Completion gate](../concepts/completion-gate.md).

## Fusion options

`/ultracode-fusion` and `/ultrathink-fusion` take these options before the task:

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--panel <agent>` | A panel agent for this run. Give it twice. | `ultracode-fusion-panel-a` and `ultracode-fusion-panel-b` |
| `--decider <agent>` | The agent that decides, or `selected-model` for the model you selected. | `ultracode-fusion-arbiter` |

A fusion run has five rounds: each panel answers, criticises the other answer, revises its own, ranks the answers, and the decider chooses. A run with one round is reported as `panel-consult`.

## Configuration command

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/ultracode-fusion-models` | Shows the three fusion models. |
| `/ultracode-fusion-models --panel-a <ref> --panel-b <ref> --decider <ref>` | Changes the named roles. Each option is optional. |

A `<ref>` is `provider/model` or `provider/model#max`. This command starts no workflow.
